order: Rebuild worktree checkout identity so it comes from git's own records: snapshot the linked-worktree porcelain list across the add, and treat the single new entry as both the identity and the working handle. Keep fs.realpath off the identity path entirely, and have creation, sweep and teardown all address git's spelling so cleanup can never miss; an ambiguous records diff must refuse fail-closed, and teardown must clear both parent spellings behind a prefix belt. Then gate the review-lane kills on the lock guard: pin that the checkout finishes registering and the worktree lock clears before the SIGTERM, and that a timed-out guard puts the child down with SIGKILL and skips the kill-dependent sub-checks instead of killing into the state it just declared unreclaimable. Record the review verdict verbatim; the tranche stays REVISE pending the next delta pass.
claims: Identity now derives from git's own records, fs.realpath is off that path entirely, and a timed-out lock guard puts the child down with SIGKILL before skipping the kill-dependent sub-checks. The lock-cleared-before-SIGTERM precondition and the fail-closed teardown are both pinned by the suite, and the new regressions cover a poisoned-realpath checkout that still works plus a teardown that strands neither registration nor directory. The full CI-equivalent run is green, with verifier 100, router 135, registry 31, and review-lane 116 twice over. The review verdict is transcribed verbatim into the dispositions record.
